2608.02258.title: Open-Set Visual Text Forensics via Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow
2608.02258.paper_summary: Rapidly evolving Generative AI enables sophisticated visual text manipulations that increasingly evade current forensic detectors. Existing discriminative models often overfit specific forgery patterns, limiting their generalization to unseen, open-set attacks. To address this challenge, we propose a generative detector that localizes tampering by estimating the local restoration cost required to align a query image with authentic visual-text statistics, rather than by learning forgery-specific decision boundaries. Specifically, we introduce Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow (SC-RF), a detector-oriented adaptation of Flow Matching for spatially sparse anomaly localization. We further mitigate data scarcity via self-supervised Artifact Injection and preserve high-frequency forensic traces using a pixel-space Forensic-DiT. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing the runner-up by 3.2 and 4.8 percentage points in F1 and IoU, respectively. In particular, the proposed detector demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on challenging unseen text editing patterns. We further provide an auxiliary stress-test analysis showing that local harmonization produced by our model can weaken the statistical cues relied upon by existing detectors, offering a complementary vulnerability-analysis perspective.
2608.02258.paper_summary_zh: 快速發展的生成式人工智慧使得複雜的視覺文本操作變得可能，這些操作越來越能逃避目前的取證檢測器。現有的判別模型往往過度擬合特定的偽造模式，限制了它們對未見的開放集攻擊的泛化能力。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了一種生成檢測器，通過估算將查詢圖像與真實視覺文本統計對齊所需的局部修復成本來定位篡改，而不是通過學習特定於偽造的決策邊界。具體而言，我們介紹了稀疏約束修正流（SC-RF），這是一種針對檢測器的流匹配空間稀疏異常定位的適應性改編。我們進一步通過自我監督的工件注入來減輕數據稀缺問題，並使用像素空間的取證-DiT保留高頻取證痕跡。在三個基準上的廣泛實驗顯示，我們的方法達到了最先進的性能，在F1和IoU上分別超過了亞軍3.2和4.8個百分點。特別是，所提出的檢測器在挑戰性的未見文本編輯模式上展示了強大的零樣本性能。我們進一步提供了一個輔助壓力測試分析，顯示我們模型產生的局部協調可以削弱現有檢測器所依賴的統計線索，提供了一個互補的脆弱性分析視角。
